posts.title: I Built My Own Ambilight for Under ₹1k, on the Same ESP32 That Runs My AI Desk Pet
posts.description: 102 WS2812B LEDs, one ESP32, custom firmware and HyperHDR on a Mac. How I built a monitor Ambilight for under ₹1,000 and beat a 287 ms bug.

posts.title: Reverse-Engineering a Xiaomi Camera Into a Self-Tracking Robot
posts.description: I reverse-engineered a Xiaomi camera into a local self-tracking robot using computer vision, measured control loops, and stock firmware.

posts.title: I Built a Chrome Dino Game Environment for Humans, Bots, and LLMs
posts.description: Learn how I built a deterministic Chrome Dino game over WebSockets where humans, bots and LLMs share one protocol, with planning that beats latency.
